column3: Kanako Route
After that...
Just like she declared, Kanako called me out occasionally.
Hey... I got something to consult you about.
Oh, it's been a while since I've heard that.
Don't make fun of me.
Sorry. So, what is it?
She's really sweating hard... Is it such a serious issue?
...Ayase asked me to lend her "SisxSis".
Pfft.
...Are you serious?
...Yeah.
...Hey, what do you think I should do?
She's asking me such a difficult question...
That Ayase... So she's continuing "Operation Overcome Otaku-phobia" on her own... What perseverance.
L-Lend it to her?
Isn't that impossible?! In the first place, how did she know about SisxSis?
...It wasn't because you told her, right?
How is that possible?
Sorry, Kirino. It was me.
But Ayase already played SisxSis once, so I think it should alright to lend it to her, right?
To be safe, how about lending her the all-ages version?
...I wonder if that's all right?
Well...
Sorry, phone call... Hello.
Kyousuke? It's me, it's me.
You.
Come out with me to shop for a while...
...Does she want me to buy her clothes this time?
...When?
Huh～? Isn't it obvious that I mean right now?
Now... Hey, I might have my own plans as well, you know?
Ah, so～ it's～ like～ that. Kyousuke Manager-san, Kanako is very hurt.
Okay, okay, okay, okay! I'll be right there!
Ah, this time, I might be entangled with a truly troublesome woman.
Sorry Kirino, I have to go out.
Huh?! Aren't we still in the middle of our conversation?!
This is to protect your secret!
It's okay if it's Ayase. Believe in your best friend.
Don't say such irresponsible things!
Should I just tell her "I'm hurrying"? Damn it...!
I'm off, Kirino!
Wait...!
...*pant pant pant*...
You're really slow. How many years were you planning to make me wait?
I thought you would snap at me like that; that's why I ran here, you know? I didn't even take 10 minutes.
That won't do. From now on, when Kanako calls you out, you have to be here within 5 minutes. Understood?
You black-hearted girl!
Hehehe. Well, let's go～♪
...Why are you linking your arm with mine?
It's a reward, a reward for Host-kun. Hehe, aren't you happy?
...Not really.
No need to pretend.
I'm not.
It's about time we went back. Ah, I'm a bit tired.
...After playing around that much, that's to be expected.
I bought her clothes, treated her at the arcade...
You're really a high maintenance woman, aren't you?
Thank you for today! Let's hang out again next time.
...I'd prefer it if there weren't a next time, though.
Don't say such cold words～
Hey, hey, Kyousuke♪
Hmm?
I love you①
Yeah, yeah, me too.
The one you love is not me, but rather my wallet, right?
Yo.
Yo. So... why did you call me out this morning?
Let's go watch a movie.
*sigh*...
Hey, what's with that attitude?
Can't you show a bit more happiness when such a cute girl asks you out?
You know... this feels like a date, doesn't it?
H-Huh?! Gross, what are you saying?
Well, it's true that I've been hanging out with you a lot recently.
But you're just Kanako's designated host... Don't forget that, all right?
...Yes, ma'am.
It's good that you understand. Then, shall we go watch this movie today?
As she said it, she passed a brochure to me.
...A romance movie, huh.
I-I want to watch that. Do you have any complaints?
Nope, nothing at all. I have no complaints at all, Kanako-sama. Until we reach the cinema, shall we link arms like before?
G-Get over yourself, you lolicon. It was a reward for you last time; don't expect such service every time!
Ah... That was interesting! Wasn't that great? Hey, hey, wasn't it?
...You sure do like these kinds of super-cliched romance movies.
...What an unexpected fact.
I-Is that bad?
Nope, it's fine, isn't it?
I think it's normal for girls to like romance.
...Shut up.
That kind of development isn't possible in reality. That kind of couple doesn't exist either.
Even idiots understand that. It's all fictional and fake. But...
That's the good part about it.
...Heh.
Both the guy and the girl are good people, they love each other very much, and they stay together till the end.
Even if it's fiction, that's fine.
At that moment, Kanako didn't look like a young brat,
but instead a far older, adult-like woman.
Do you have a boyfriend?
...Why do you ask? Are you interested?
Kind of.
Kanako shifted her eyes away from me, and looked off somewhere into the far distance.
I don't.
...Why are you so shocked?
I thought you would have a lot of experience in relationships. I've heard many stories about you from Kirino.
Ah, things like guys providing for me and treating me?
Yup.
Those guys aren't my boyfriends. I'm just hanging out with them.
...That's dangerous.
That's why, I've never had a boyfriend.
Hmm.
...Are you relieved?
Why would I be?
Hehehe.
Ahem... You shouldn't do those kinds of things. It's dangerous to be alone with guys that you don't know...
Wait... Doesn't that include me?
I am, in fact, "hanging out" with her right now, after all...
Gyahaha, you're talking like an old man.
Yeah. It sounds like what my father would say to me too.
I've already stopped doing that.
Eh?
...I have an obedient host now, after all.
...That's good to know.
Kanako moved away from me and looked up at the setting sun while spreading her arms.
Ah... That was fun.
It's nice... Kanako also wishes to experience that sort of thing.
That sort of thing?
A kiss.
Guh.
There's a lot of people here, just like the scene in the movie, right?
She's referring to...
...the passionate kissing scene on a street during a sunset.
...Want to try it?
As if!
It's fine. Come on, it's just a kiss. Okay?
I won't do it!
Stop joking around! As if I could do that!
You actually want to do it, don't you? This is probably the last chance in your life to do so, you know?
I won't do it.
...Tch, you just can't play along...
...Well then, it's an order.
...W-What?
If you don't kiss me, I'll reveal your secret.
You...
...Do whatever you want.
Eh, eh?
Go ahead and reveal it if you want to. Make a fool of me if you like. I'm not going along with it.
Don't do these kind of things to people who you don't truly like.
Wha...
You...!
What is it?
Are you an idiot!! I don't care about you anymore!!
You better remember this!!
Ah, hey!
What's with her...
This isn't good. I told her to reveal whatever she wants, but... What should I do?
After that, I didn't hear from Kanako, and several days passed without incident.
